preview.text: Qatar and Thailand are playing a T20 match at Bayuemas Oval, where the usual first-innings score in the 85 recorded T20 matches is 118. Qatar won the toss and chose to bowl first. The forecast for the next 8 hours indicates up to a 44 per cent chance of rain and about 27 degrees.

summary.text: Qatar won by 7 wkts after restricting THAI to 76-9, in an innings where Chaloemwong Chatphaisan was the top scorer with 16 off 13 balls and Shariq Munir took 2 for 8. QAT then chased the target with 80-3, led by top scorer Zeeshan Haider with 47 off 41 balls despite Chanchai Pengkumta claiming 2 for 13.
